cut: In src/serve.rs, use an AtomicBool for whether any connection arrived, choose the expiry fault suffix and fix together, and pass them to one Refusal::of call. In src/firewall.rs, make SIGNATURE a single flag so src/doctor.rs can pass a two-element argument array without concatenating slices and examples/standin.rs can match the flag and path in one slice pattern.
answer: Both made: serve.rs counts with an AtomicBool and builds one Refusal::of from the chosen suffix and fix; firewall::SIGNATURE is one flag, doctor passes [SIGNATURE, binary], the stand-in matches [flag, path].
